title: Fractured membranes under determinant constraints: the case of cohesive surface energies
summary: This paper is devoted to the variational derivation of reduced models for elastic membranes with fracture under constraints on the determinant of the deformation gradient. We consider two physically relevant settings: the orientation-preserving regime, in which the deformation is required to preserve orientation locally ($\det \nabla u > 0$), and the incompressible regime, in which the deformation preserves volume ($\det \nabla u = 1$). In both cases, the surface energy density is allowed to depend on the jump amplitude, thus encompassing cohesive fracture models with activation threshold.…
